scenario.name: Localise Ford parts to USMCA content
scenario.description: Re-source castings and forgings into North America so Ford's parts meet USMCA regional value content and stay duty-free under a parts tariff. A localisation cost per piece replaces the tariff. This is the structural answer to the first scenario rather than a forecast of one.
